name: Seika
source:
A girl who has been spending more than two years living in the 8th Training School.
She is a strong-willed person with actual combat experience, although she is not confident about her own abilities. She is seen as a prodigy who can do anything, but does not have any specific strong points. Souga remarks that she is a "Jack of all trades, master of none," which fairly concerns her.
